subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should #84569 remain the canonical incident tracker for both WhatsApp final-error delivery and Codex timed-out lane release, or should maintainers split the remaining WhatsApp delivery work under #87561 after #94833 lands?
rationale: The current source proves the bug remains, but the durable fallback contract in #87561 and the open #94833 candidate make the permanent ownership split a maintainer/product choice.

options.title: Keep #84569 canonical until both slices close
options.body: Leave this issue open as the concrete production incident until #94833 lands or is replaced and the WhatsApp final-error delivery path no longer suppresses visible fallbacks.

options.title: Split after Codex lane fix lands
options.body: After #94833 resolves the lane-release slice, keep the remaining final-fallback delivery work under #87561 and close this only with explicit cross-links.

options.title: Scope a new narrow WhatsApp PR
options.body: Revive or replace #84578 as a focused WhatsApp compliance patch while #87561 continues to own cross-channel semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep #84569 canonical until both slices close
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the concrete production incident until #94833 lands or is replaced and the WhatsApp final-error delivery path no longer suppresses visible fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned to #84569 and owns the broader durable final fallback contract issue that determines the split.
